en: Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt
zh: Claude 应用网关的 Bedrock 上游新增 `guardrail.input_tagging`，用于将 prompts 包裹在 Amazon Bedrock guardrail 的 prompt 攻击过滤器所需的输入标签中；`all_messages_and_system` 还会标记 system prompt
